_comment: Vocalization-detection benchmark results. This file exists so the demo notebook LOADS these numbers instead of hardcoding them in markdown. Values are transcribed from the Savio jobs listed under provenance; the full 12-layer array lives in the artifact named there. Layers listed in layers_unavailable_here were measured in that job but are not reproduced in this file, so the notebook plots gaps rather than inventing them.

provenance.supersedes: An earlier run reported AUC 0.984 with deep layers best. It was computed on corrupted ground truth (see known_issues_fixed) and is RETRACTED. Do not cite it.

dataset.how_ground_truth_was_built: The curated AdultVocalization clips are near-exact excerpts of the continuous colony recordings. Each clip was localized back into its source recording by normalized cross-correlation: a coarse 4 kHz search proposes top-k candidate offsets (non-max suppressed), each candidate is re-scored at full resolution, and acceptance is decided only by that scale-invariant verified peak (min-peak 0.65). The accepted intervals supply the onsets/offsets.
dataset.normalize_scope: context (20 s, matching the pretraining chunk)
dataset.negative_class_is_NOT_silence: Background windows are sampled from the same colony recordings and contain cage noise, wing flaps, movement, and UNCURATED vocalizations. Because 'background' operationally means 'not a curated call', the detector is penalized when it correctly fires on a real call that nobody curated. Precision is therefore a pessimistic LOWER BOUND, not an estimate.
dataset.known_limitation: No human has verified the background windows. Review bundles were generated (voc_detect_review_36020417/, mined_negatives_*/) but their human_label column is still empty, so the false-positive rate is not yet measured.

pre_transformer.note: CNN feature extractor + projection, i.e. the input to block 0. Measured in job 37653314.

headline.trend: AUC declines monotonically with transformer depth (0.921 at layer 0 -> 0.883 at layer 11). The decline does NOT extrapolate backwards past block 0: the pre-transformer CNN output scores 0.852, worse than layer 0 by more than the entire layer-0-to-layer-11 decline.

known_issues_fixed: Normalized cross-correlation blew up inside long runs of exact digital zeros: the denominator collapsed to its 1e-12 floor while FFT round-off remained in the numerator, producing 'correlations' of ~76 where brute force gives 0.016. This pinned some accepted intervals to SILENCE, which made the task partly silence-vs-audio, inflated AUC to 0.984, and made deep layers look best. Fixed by the two-stage verified-peak procedure plus degenerate-window guards.
The coarse search ran at 1 kHz, lowpassing at 500 Hz, below most zebra finch call energy; it recovered 0/12 clips on one date where a 4 kHz search recovers 12/12. Fixed by searching at 4 kHz.
AppleDouble ._* sidecar files were being enumerated as real clips, doubling the apparent clip count.
